summary.name: Redis
summary.one_liner: Redis is a real-time data platform (in-memory database) offered as open source Redis 8, managed cloud, and Redis Enterprise, with AI agent context and vector search features.
use_cases: Caching and fast data access for apps
Providing real-time context to AI apps and agents
Vector search over structured and unstructured data
Hosting Redis in the cloud without managing servers
Storing TB-scale data with tiered RAM and flash
summary.what_it_does: The page promotes Redis as a real-time data platform for agents and apps. It offers Redis Iris as a real-time context engine for AI apps and Redis Context Retriever, which uses Redis-powered vector search over structured and unstructured data. Redis can be hosted in the cloud by Redis, or users can manage their own deployments. Redis 8 is available as free open source software. Enterprise features named include Flex (tiered RAM plus flash storage for TB-scale data) and Active-Active (multi-region replication with zero-downtime failover). The listing from awesome-mac describes a separate tool, RedisDesktopManager, as a cross-platform GUI for Redis, but the page itself does not mention it.
notable: Redis Iris real-time context engine for AI apps
Flex tiered RAM and flash storage for TB-scale data at up to 80% less cost
Active-Active multi-region replication with zero-downtime failover
Redis 8 available as free open source download
caveats: Enterprise features such as Flex and Active-Active are sold as part of Redis Enterprise; pricing is not stated on the page
Cloud hosting pricing is not given beyond a per-session figure for the agent memory benchmark
The page is mostly marketing and does not describe the RedisDesktopManager GUI it is listed under
